Painted like a vintage Indian sports-magazine centre spread from the 1980s: deep outfield greens, chalk white and cherry red, dramatic angle, faded glossy print. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
